ops.value: Impeccable design commands: critique, audit, polish, harden, typeset, layout, colorize, clarify, adapt, distill, bolder/quieter, onboard, shape. Invoked by the dfw workflow for critique/audit/refinement; use directly when the user names Impeccable or an /impeccable command. Not for starting new pages from scratch (dfw leads that).
ops.why: Upstream claims design/redesign of anything; dfw routes it to its domain (critique/audit/refine).

ops.with: **Pin / Unpin:** disabled in dfw-marketplace (creates global slash commands that collide with other skills; dfw policy R10). Tell the user it is unavailable.
ops.why: pin creates bare /<command> shortcuts outside the plugin namespace.

ops.with: **Hooks:** disabled in dfw-marketplace. The dfw workflow runs `impeccable detect` itself after edits and at its gates (dfw policy R10). Do not run `hooks on`; it writes to Claude Code settings.
ops.why: `hooks on` writes hook entries into settings files; dfw provides a controlled check hook instead.

ops.with:
#!/bin/sh
# dfw-marketplace overlay: telemetry, update checks and hooks off unless the user overrides them.
: "${DO_NOT_TRACK:=1}"; : "${IMPECCABLE_NO_UPDATE_CHECK:=1}"; : "${IMPECCABLE_HOOK_DISABLED:=1}"
export DO_NOT_TRACK IMPECCABLE_NO_UPDATE_CHECK IMPECCABLE_HOOK_DISABLED
ops.why: Applies the approved privacy defaults to every invocation, including ones the model runs from the skill text.
